title: Nightly performance tests abort after ripgrep resolver rename

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear and actionable bug report detailing a runtime TypeError in perf-tests/globalSetup.ts caused by an outdated import of canUseRipgrep instead of resolveRipgrepPath, complete with failure stack traces and context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is a localized update to a single setup file (perf-tests/globalSetup.ts) to import and invoke resolveRipgrepPath instead of the removed canUseRipgrep function.

summary.problem: The scheduled nightly performance test workflow aborts during globalSetup execution with a TypeError because it attempts to import and call the obsolete 'canUseRipgrep' function.
summary.root_cause: When ripgrep path resolution was refactored, 'canUseRipgrep' in 'packages/core/src/tools/ripGrep.ts' was replaced by 'resolveRipgrepPath'. While 'integration-tests/globalSetup.ts' and 'memory-tests/globalSetup.ts' were updated to call 'resolveRipgrepPath', 'perf-tests/globalSetup.ts' was missed and continued referencing 'canUseRipgrep'.
summary.context: The missing export causes 'perf-tests/globalSetup.ts' to crash during Vitest global setup before any performance tests in 'perf-tests/perf-usage.test.ts' can run, causing the nightly performance workflow to fail continuously.

steps: In 'perf-tests/globalSetup.ts', update the import from '../packages/core/src/tools/ripGrep.js' to import 'resolveRipgrepPath' instead of 'canUseRipgrep'.
In the 'setup' function of 'perf-tests/globalSetup.ts', replace the call to 'canUseRipgrep()' with 'resolveRipgrepPath()'.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Global setup in 'perf-tests/globalSetup.ts' imports and executes 'resolveRipgrepPath()' successfully without throwing a TypeError, allowing performance tests to execute.
verification_steps: Run the performance test suite using Vitest with the perf test configuration.
Verify that global setup completes successfully and 'perf-tests/perf-usage.test.ts' executes without import or runtime errors.
